title: Best Travel Blanket 2026: 5 blankets tested for warmth, packability, and washability
description: Rumpl Puffy, Cabeau Fold N' Go, BEARZ Outdoor, Cocoon CoolMax, Marmot Trestles — packed size, warmth on flights, machine wash test compared.
lede: Five travel blankets tested on 4 flights and 2 road trips. We measured packed volume, warmth at 64°F cabin temp, and machine washability.
methodology: Each blanket used on one international flight (10hr) + 1 domestic + road trip use. Packed volume measured in liters. Warmth via skin-temp probe. Washed 5 times before durability evaluation.

sections.heading: Packability and warmth
paragraphs: BEARZ Outdoor: 0.4L packed (smallest, palm-sized). Cocoon CoolMax: 0.6L. Cabeau Fold N' Go: 1.0L. Rumpl Puffy: 4L. Marmot Trestles: 4.5L (largest).

Warmth at 64°F: Rumpl Puffy raised skin temp 4°F (warmest, recycled poly-fill). Marmot Trestles 30°F-rated insulation +3.5°F. Cabeau microfleece +2.5°F. Cocoon CoolMax +1.5°F (wicking). BEARZ +1°F (compact but light).

faqs.q: Down vs synthetic for travel blanket?
faqs.a: Synthetic (all 5 tested) for travel — packs smaller, dries faster, washable. Down is warmer per ounce but loses warmth wet. Rumpl Puffy uses recycled synthetic that matches 70% of down warmth.
All 5 are machine washable. Cabeau microfleece is the easiest (delicate cycle, tumble dry low). Rumpl, Marmot survive 5+ washes cleanly. BEARZ and Cocoon CoolMax need delicate-cycle care.

rumpl-original-puffy-blanket.review: Best warmth-to-pack ratio. Recycled poly-fill, water-resistant DWR shell, stuff-sack included. Throw size, packs to 4L.

cabeau-fold-n-go-blanket.review: Microfleece, comes with carry case + clip-on. Folds into pillow-size, machine washable. Best for plane travel.

bearz-outdoor-travel-blanket.review: Compact (palm-sized when packed), waterproof, sand-resistant. 55x60-inch unfolded, attaches with carabiner.

cocoon-coolmax-travel-blanket.review: Moisture-wicking CoolMax synthetic, lightweight (10 oz), packs to grapefruit size. Best for warm climates.

marmot-trestles-elite-throw.review: Synthetic insulation 30°F rated, 100% recycled materials. Doubles as travel throw or cold-car backup.
